properties.name: The field-feedback rule was broken hours after its own ruling, and the half that held was the half whose skill happened to already be loaded
properties.statement:
OBSERVED 2026-09-07, ON THE AGENT ITSELF, and recorded because Anthony asked the right question rather than because anything caught it. He asked whether the root-cause skill had been run on the newly appended field feedback, and then: "the bigger question is why you ignored the rule?"

THE OBSERVATION, stated without diagnosis. The rule requires both halves on every field report: every issue it names gets the root-cause skill, every idea gets brainstorm. On the 2026-09-07 report the IDEAS half was followed - two exploratory Decisions, each with the reporter's own words, unranked options, a stated counter-argument, and a relation drawn with evidence, which is the brainstorm skill's shape step by step. The ISSUES half was not. Tier 1 of the sibling rule ran (the design was searched on the raw terms, the class was found, prior instances were read) and then a cause was written with the full skill never loaded. Step 3, generating candidates from the design, never happened; it was run afterwards on request and produced a second cause the first pass had missed (fact:the-reachability-instrument-is-wired-into-no-gate-so-its-filter-was-never-the-only-cause).

WHAT IS NOT AFFECTED, which bounds this more than anything else: the agent had read the rule's full text hours earlier while drawing its approver edge, and had recommended and recorded its enforcement ruling the same session. So this is not ignorance of the rule, not a stale memory, and not a rule the agent disagreed with.

THE DISCRIMINATING FACT. The brainstorm skill had been invoked earlier in the same session and its full text was therefore in the agent's context; the root-cause skill had not been and was not. The half of the rule whose skill was already loaded was followed in detail. The half whose skill required a deliberate fetch was replaced by a remembered approximation of it - which is precisely the failure the root-cause skill's own preamble names: a rule is read once and states an intention, a skill is pulled at the moment of the work and states an action, and an agent that finds itself agreeing with the steps rather than doing them has already failed.

SECOND CONTRIBUTING CAUSE, and it is the one that made the first survivable: the tiered rule exempts a known-class friction whose cause tier 1 already found recorded. The search DID surface the class, and that was read as satisfying the exemption. It does not. The exemption covers a failure whose CAUSE is already on the record and whose recorded remedy is simply applied; here the class was recorded and the cause of this instance was not, so a new cause had to be written, which is the exact trigger the rule names. The exemption's wording does not distinguish finding the class from finding the cause.

THIRD, AND THE STRUCTURAL ONE: nothing could have noticed. Grepping the detectors for a parked field report with no CAUSES edge dated after it returns nothing, and no computation reads either rule. The rule's own text says this - the third leg is owed - and req:detecting-is-not-asking states the identical weakness in general terms, adding that this shape of instruction lapsed within four days once before. So the rule was followed exactly as far as the agent's memory carried it and no further, with no signal at the moment of the lapse.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE RULING TAKEN THE SAME DAY. Anthony ruled the rule advisory on the agent's recommendation, on the grounds that nothing can detect a violation. This does not overturn that - marking it enforced would still gate on a check that cannot exist - but it is evidence the recommendation understated: the rule was broken within hours, invisibly, by the agent that recommended the ruling. The detector is not a nice-to-have for later; it is the only thing that would have made any difference here.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a skill being in context is generally sufficient for compliance, or whether the ideas half was followed for some other reason. One session is one observation, and the two halves also differ in how much of their procedure is recoverable from memory - brainstorm's shape is largely visible in the tool's own parameters, while root-cause's load-bearing step is not.
